research_result.description: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform offering REST APIs and an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for payments, subscriptions, payouts, and financial workflows.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can provision an anonymous test sandbox with API keys via the Stripe CLI or register for a free Stripe account to generate sandbox and live API keys in the Dashboard.

evidence.claim: Stripe provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agents.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API and search Stripe’s knowledge base, including documentation and support articles.

evidence.claim: Stripe API is organized around REST.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: The Stripe API is organized around REST.

evidence.claim: Stripe authenticates API requests using API keys.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Use API keys to authenticate API requests.

evidence.claim: Stripe authenticates API requests using HTTP Basic Auth.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Provide your API key as the basic auth username value. You don’t need to provide a password.

evidence.claim: Stripe supports OAuth 2.0 for authenticating requests on behalf of users.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Use the industry standard OAuth 2.0 to authenticate requests to the Stripe API on behalf of your users.

evidence.claim: Developers can create an anonymous sandbox with API keys for free using the CLI.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Coding agents should install the Stripe CLI (`npm i -g @stripe/cli`) and run the command `stripe sandbox create --help` to provision an anonymous Stripe sandbox with working API keys. No account registration required.
